description: MLP gate/up: F-D2 (the multiply written to L1) with the streaming config, then F-D1 (gate and up as one launch with the SwiGLU epilogue); then F-D3 (the same fused launch with a bank-strided multi-tile weight reader)

levers.name: MLP streaming config and L1 multiply
levers.reason: F-D2: the 64-row MLP's multiply is written to L1 instead of DRAM and read from L1 by the down matmul; with a QWEN_FAST_MLP_CFG name (g<n>u<n>d<n>) the gate, up and down 1D-mcast matmuls are re-partitioned over more or fewer cores with the K loop (in0_block_w) unchanged, so every output tile is reduced over K as before

levers.name: MLP fused gate|up with SwiGLU epilogue
levers.reason: F-D1: the gate and up matmuls and their multiply become one launch (tp4_mlp_fused, a port of the TP2 FusedProjection to 64 rows and the TP4 shape, reading the served w1 and w3): the SiLU at the gate's pack, bf16 rounding of gate and up, a bf16 product left in L1 for the down matmul

levers.name: MLP fused gate|up with a bank-strided weight reader
levers.reason: F-D3: the fused gate|up launch of F-D1 with each worker owning 4 columns of ONE DRAM bank and reading a tile row's run as one request (the card-M read probe C5: 403 GB/s at 4 tiles against 294 for the stock one-request-per-tile pattern), two compute subblocks (the gate run, the up run) and a paired SwiGLU epilogue, the served w1 and w3 read in place; QWEN_FAST_MLP_GATEUP_BANK_CHUNK=2|3|4 is the request size (default 4), _DEPTH=2|3|4 the K blocks its circular buffers hold (default 2) and _SUB the output subblock width (a divisor of the chunk; default the chunk). It excludes QWEN_FAST_MLP_GATEUP, and QWEN_FAST_MLP_CFG may name only d and w beside it

pack_last.reason: F-D1's fused kernels have never compiled on a card: run the card-M job C3 (fusion-jobs/WP4, the product against the served multiply, bit for bit) first, and these four-card arms last, so that a compile failure or a differing product costs the least of the window.

F-D3's bank-strided kernels have never compiled on a card: run the card-M job C6 (fusion-jobs/WP4: the product against the served multiply bit for bit, the pair and the full chain timed against the served and the g3u4d3 chains) first. These four-card arms run last, and the lever joins the combined fx-all twin only after C6 reads BANK-GO (see the notes).

image_files.reason: this branch edits bind_two_tile_mlp (the lever's binder takes the MLP binder's place when one of the ten QWEN_FAST_MLP_* flags is in the environment; with none the function returns what it returned); the image holds it at the P8 commit through the Dockerfile copy list, so an edit reaches it only through the overlay
the levers' flags, config grammar, plan, twin forward, binder and audit; model_batch.two_tile_bindings imports it only when one of its flags is set
F-D1: the fused gate|up launch (host plan, compute-kernel patch, program descriptors); bindings() imports it on QWEN_FAST_MLP_GATEUP=1
JIT source of the fused launch's activation multicast; without it the fused arm fails at its first launch
JIT source of the fused launch's weight reader and output writer (the padding slots of a short last worker are zeroed once before the K loop, not per K block)
F-D3: the bank-strided fused gate|up launch (host plan, compute-kernel patch, program descriptors); bindings() imports it on QWEN_FAST_MLP_GATEUP_BANK=1
JIT source of the bank launch's weight reader (one request per tile row and tensor, bank-contiguous) and output writer; its activation multicast is tp4_mlp_fused_input.cpp

tests.reason: flags, builder against the graft's transcription, the K-loop proofs, the twin forward beside the real grafted _forward_tp, the audit, the binder and the model_batch hook, the job templates
F-D1: the host plan, the compute patch against fused_1d.fused_compute, the kernels' data movement transliterated, the program descriptors

F-D3: the bank plan on both grids and against the read probe's worker plan, the compute patch, the weights kernel's data movement transliterated over a reduced problem (bank-contiguous reads, two subblocks, paired epilogue, one-time zeroed padding), the program descriptors
the card-M harness's own tests (a new directory; the workflow runs the sibling harness directories the same way)

card_jobs: scripts/ci/references/fusion-jobs/WP4/ (ORDER.txt; C1 the card-M sweep FIRST, C2 the same on the 11x10 clamp (MLP_GRID_CLAMP in the job's C2_CARDM_ENV: the card-M harnesses do not take the step's C2_TT_GRID), C3 the fused op, C4 the other four 1D decode matmuls, C5 the diagnostics (format, request size, SiLU split), C6 the bank-strided fused op against the served pair and chain, C7 its buffer-depth, subblock and ablation variants); the four-card audited attach and ABAB of the three levers come from make_fusion_jobs.py
notes: What the integrator wires, in order: (1) packed_verifier, beside tile_collective_tp.audit_claim / audit_replayed / audit_round / audit_release: tp4_mlp_gateup.audit_claim(fixture, 'warm' or 'capture') after the warm forward and after the capture, tp4_mlp_gateup.audit_replayed(fixture) after each replay, tp4_mlp_gateup.audit_round(operations, fixture, round_number) with the other audit rounds, tp4_mlp_gateup.audit_release(operations, fixture) before the fixture closes; with the audit flags off nothing is held and the calls return 0. Without them an audited arm logs no 'audit ... exact=True' line and the fusion smoke rule fails it by name. (2) scripts/ci/two_tile_decode.py is edited by this branch (bind_two_tile_mlp: the lever's binder takes the MLP binder's place, in the same slot of the same four-tuple, only when one of the ten QWEN_FAST_MLP_* names is in the environment; the module is not imported otherwise) and is listed under image_files. model_batch.py is NOT edited: test_quad_draft pins it to the serving bundle's text. (3) Two registries this branch cannot update for itself (one line each; every test green in the integrated tree, checked on fusion-1 plus this branch plus those two lines): scripts/ci/test_tp4_closure_literals.py SERVED needs `tp4_mlp_gateup tp4_mlp_fused tp4_mlp_bank` (two_tile_decode imports the first lazily and it imports the second; with them listed the test passes, scanned clean of pair literals), scripts/ci/test_serving_image_copy_closure.py C2_ONLY_PLAIN_IMPORTS needs `tp4_mlp_gateup.py` (two_tile_decode, a P8-copied module, plain-imports it under the flags only; it is overlay-only like the other op-fusion modules there), and the stricter smoke rule is named under smoke_rules (tp4_mlp_gateup_smoke.problems(env, container_text), host side, not shipped to the image: it adds the route and configuration name, rows=64, layers=64 and the L1 multiply to the generic fusion rules). (4) Not needed: tp_addresses rows (the lever binds an instance attribute per layer, no pinned module is twinned), profiles beyond the two levers (after card job C1 prints the tuned name, add {"name": "mlpcfg-tuned", "env": {"QWEN_FAST_MLP_CFG": "<name>"}, "audit": false} and its audited twin to profiles[] and regenerate). 13x10: nothing in the lever hard-codes a grid; the harness and the binder read compute_with_storage_grid_size, the sweep covers up to 130 cores, the fused op lays its workers on the device width. (5) F-D3 (mlpbank, QWEN_FAST_MLP_GATEUP_BANK=1, audit QWEN_FAST_MLP_GATEUP_BANK_AUDIT, chunk QWEN_FAST_MLP_GATEUP_BANK_CHUNK=2|3|4, default 4): the first registry of (3) also takes tp4_mlp_bank (test_tp4_closure_literals.py SERVED needs `tp4_mlp_gateup tp4_mlp_fused tp4_mlp_bank`: tp4_mlp_gateup.bindings imports it lazily; checked: without it the test names ('tp4_mlp_bank', tp4_mlp_gateup, bindings) unclassified; C2_ONLY_PLAIN_IMPORTS stays `tp4_mlp_gateup.py` alone, since tp4_mlp_bank is imported by an overlay-only module), and the overlay takes the two new image_files. The lever is pack_last and is NOT to be added to the combined fx-all twin until the card-M job C6 (fusion-jobs/WP4) reads BANK-GO (exact on every chunk it keeps, and a gain over the g3u4d3 chain); then fx-all takes lever mlpbank with the mlpcfg value changed from g3u4d3 to d3 (QWEN_FAST_MLP_CFG may not name g or u beside the bank lever: resolve() refuses the profile at warm, and the smoke rule reports it), and WP0's smoke row for QWEN_FAST_MLP_CFG g3u4d3 becomes d3. The same change zeroes the padding slots of F-D1's short last worker once before the K loop (tp4_mlp_fused_weights.cpp): C3 should be rerun for p3/p5/p7 if F-D1 is still wanted. (6) C6 read BANK-MARGINAL (bank c3 plus the d3 down 156.84 us a layer against the g3u4d3 chain's 162.28: 0.348 ms a pass, threshold 0.35), so the lever stays out of fx-all. C7 (fusion-jobs/WP4, arm bankopt) times what could close the gap to the read-only floors: QWEN_FAST_MLP_GATEUP_BANK_DEPTH=3|4 and QWEN_FAST_MLP_GATEUP_BANK_SUB=<divisor of the chunk> (both default off: depth 2, subblock = chunk, which is the byte-identical kernel text C6 ran), and two timing-only cuts. Whatever C7's verdict prints (`MLP_GATEUP env ...`) is the profile env to use if it reads BANK-GO: the three flags beside QWEN_FAST_MLP_GATEUP_BANK=1 and QWEN_FAST_MLP_CFG=d3. The two flags are in the same eight-name list (two_tile_decode.MLP_LEVER_FLAGS is now ten names) and add no registry line.
